    org.openqa.selenium.logging.LogType.CLIENT

    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.CLEAR_LOCAL_STORAGE
    localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.localStorage.clear()") instead.
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.CLEAR_SESSION_STORAGE
    sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.sessionStorage.clear()") instead.
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_DOWNLOADED_FILE
    use DriverCommand.DOWNLOAD_FILE instead
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_LOCAL_STORAGE_ITEM
    localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return window.localStorage.getItem('key')") instead.
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_LOCAL_STORAGE_KEYS
    localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return Object.keys(window.localStorage)") instead.
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_LOCAL_STORAGE_SIZE
    localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return window.localStorage.length") instead.
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_SESSION_STORAGE_ITEM
    sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return window.sessionStorage.getItem('key')") instead.
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_SESSION_STORAGE_KEYS
    sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return Object.keys(window.sessionStorage)") instead.
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.GET_SESSION_STORAGE_SIZE
    sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("return window.sessionStorage.length") instead.
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.REMOVE_LOCAL_STORAGE_ITEM
    localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.localStorage.removeItem('key')") instead.
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.REMOVE_SESSION_STORAGE_ITEM
    sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.sessionStorage.removeItem('key')") instead.
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.SET_LOCAL_STORAGE_ITEM
    localStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.localStorage.setItem('key', 'value')") instead.
    org.openqa.selenium.remote.DriverCommand.SET_SESSION_STORAGE_ITEM
    sessionStorage is not part of W3C WebDriver spec. Use ((JavascriptExecutor) driver).executeScript("window.sessionStorage.setItem('key', 'value')") instead.
